toneFindings.finding: Opening and order sections explain the seller’s product/ribbon/price consultation. The two third-person transitions were corrected; they do not promise facility management or installation.

toneFindings.criterion: empathy and short natural conversational context
toneFindings.finding: The opening respects difficulty finding a short condolence phrase and connects it to ribbon consultation. No invented customer memory, emotion, delivery experience or testimonial.
No sequence of instructional headings or repeated 확인하세요 directives. Required order details are grouped once in four bullets. FAQ adds unresolved-room/ribbon-photo/collection answers.
Prices, photos, total-budget arithmetic and ribbon examples lead. Unconfirmed arrival/entry conditions appear at the relevant order section. Product sample notices stay beside actual photos.

toneFindings.criterion: pressure, superiority, guarantees and fake emotional templates
toneFindings.finding: No forced higher budget for company orders, size/quality inference, free delivery, same-day deadline, fixed arrival, partnership, installation, collection, stock or refund promise.

Home/support card, 404, menu labels, phone links, metadata and descriptive banner alt fit their functions. Exact approved banner bytes retained; no new generated imagery or deleted caption reinserted.

metrics.definition: Unicode code points including spaces and one newline between selected fields. Main = detail.lead + all section paragraphs/list/afterList. FAQ = questions and answers. Complete = main + FAQ + closing. Headings/cards/menu/CTA/sources/footer excluded. Draft target, never a hard gate.
metrics.semanticReview: Common product facts and practical ordering questions naturally overlap. Naju pricing includes a verified 10000 KRW surcharge and per-SKU sums; facility identification is government-record based and distinct from Mokpo address/parking, Yeosu dual addresses and Suncheon room/religious-service descriptions. Independent full-text semantic review found no place-name-only substitution.

metricInterpretation: Original R1 measured 2590 main / 3034 with FAQ and closing. Final R2 is 2582 / 3026. Home 621 characters is a navigation/consultation page, not another long article.
